exclusions.circular_reason: tools/link_oss_components attached the CVE to a library that the same CVE put in the SBOM (OSS catalog tier A); kept in the SBOM, held out of scoring
exclusions.layer_b_reason: CISA asserts the ICS product is affected but NVD's CPE is a third-party component (e.g. Schneider ProLeiT -> redis:redis); the ICS name is absent from NVD, so no name-based matcher can reach the answer
exclusions.conflict_reason: CISA range says affected, NVD applicability says not (e.g. CVE-2024-22771: CISA 1.02-4.02 vs NVD 1.03-4.03); held out rather than labelled verified

scoring_note: version_match=None means undecidable (CISA publishes upper bounds like '<4.3.4', which pin no affected version). It must never be read as False.
